title: Larry's advice: relax and avoid pressure
summary: Asked for tone secrets, Harry says Larry only told him to relax and not bite, and that Larry used medium reeds.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Is there anything, when you first learned, that you could tell us about anything that helped you to learn to master the clarinet, to get a tone, any secrets that is in learning to get that broad tone or that your brother helped you with? I'm not trying to pry into your secrets or anything, but I mean if there is anything, it would be a benefit to other players someday. It's good not to have that knowledge lost.
Any advice that he gave you on how to blow or what to do?
Well, he did tell me to relax and don't use too much pressure.
With your lips so that you have to bite it too hard.
Yeah. So I don't use too much pressure.
He only used a medium. He didn't use a hard read then.
No, I don't think Larry ever used a real hard read.
